subtitle: Lesson 12 · Distributions

code:
from scipy import stats
d = stats.norm(loc=40, scale=5)
d.cdf(45)   # 0.8413  <= 45 min
d.sf(50)    # 0.0228  > 50 min
d.ppf(0.95) # 48.22   95th pct
caption: loc is the mean; scale is the standard deviation.

code:
for k in (1, 2, 3):
    a = stats.norm.cdf(k)
    b = stats.norm.cdf(-k)
    print(k, round(a - b, 4))
# 1 0.6827
# 2 0.9545
# 3 0.9973
caption: Share of values within k standard deviations.
A 52-minute delivery is 2.4 sd above average.
